title: Preparation of thiol-functionalized polyurethane foam and its adsorption performance for Hg(II)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39871-39884
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05379J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Meixin Chen, Lili Zhu, Juan Jin, Cunxin Sun, Zhenjiang Zhang
A chemical grafting method was employed to prepare thiol-functionalized polyurethane foam (PUF-HS). PUF-HS was utilized as an adsorbent for Hg(II) removal and its adsorption performance and mechanism were systematically investigated.
